title: Dr. G as a consortium of anti-submarine scientists, identified by the Ramseys

tellings.quote: Scott and Suzanne Ramsay have really they deserve all the credit for digging up this like kind of like short list of like eight to nine scientists that likely are being represented in this pseudonym Dr. G.

plain: An online commentator who goes by UAPGerb talks about Behind the Flying Saucers, a 1950 book by the writer Frank Scully about a saucer said to have crashed near Aztec, New Mexico, whose main scientific source was called only "Dr. G". UAPGerb credits researchers Scott and Suzanne Ramsey with digging up a shortlist of eight or nine scientists, linked to anti-submarine work, who were likely all being represented by that one pseudonym. If true, it would mean Scully's mystery source was really a group of real government scientists.
